COOLBEANZ W JWH -vs- Raw Herbs
I have been buying this Incense called: COOLBEANZ for awhile now, and on the side of the container is says that it contains 3 specific herbs. Damiana, Mugwort, and Lion's Tail. Its also $25 for 4grams at the local headshop, which got really expensive, so I devised a plan. I purchased the three herbs online, and got an OZ. Of each for less than the price of one 4gram container of COOLBEANZ.
So now I have 3oz's of Herbs in front of me. I thought if I mixed them, then I could get a similar effect as the COOLBEANZ, & in fact, I did get a nice floaty feeling, but I must say, I think they are incorrect on the ingredients list. Wild dagga is orange, and COOLBEANZ had no orange at all in it, also when I smoked the Dagga by its self, it was HORRID!!
Now , before I get a huge lecture on JWH, I already know about the absence of the 'chemical spray' in the Raw Herbs. I do however think that the Raw Un-sprayed herbs are better to smoke, and still produce some effect. The JWH spray just made me suicidal, and depressed all the time, while the raw untreated herbs seem to mellow me out, and mimic the effects MaryJane.
As far as the Dagga goes, I smoked it on a Monday night, started coughing something fierce, and by Tuesday night I had a nice little sinus infection that lasted till Friday morning. It is harsh on the throat, and is very unpleasant on the lungs. As with any herb, different folks, have different effects, but I think I will just stick to my Damiana/Mugwort mix, and stay away from the Lion's Hell altogether.
